title: 苗を守るリコ
scene: 第四章4-7 出発前／リコは籠を引き寄せ、胸に抱えてメリルの前へ立った。
selection: ユーザーがキャラクター紹介を兼ねる全身構図01を選択。リコの赤・黒衣装とメリルの脚の厚みを調整。
integration: 素材保存のみ。第四章の本編実装時に表示行を決める。
initialPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Create ONE finished landscape narrative JRPG event illustration, 1536x1024, for STARLIT-GUILD chapter 4 scene 4-7 "Lico protects the seedlings". No collage, panels, typography or dialogue.
References: image 1 is the canonical Lico character design; image 2 is the canonical Merrill character design, including her special LEFT-arm instrument gauntlet; image 3 is ONLY the existing game's rendering/style reference, do not copy its scene or cast.

Exact story moment: Outside behind an old stone tower, at the loading area of a small moss-growing site in Brekka. Lico has just snatched a woven basket of living moss transplants to her chest and physically steps between Merrill and the remaining baskets. She is protecting the plants needed to establish a new growing bed. Merrill is a food-obsessed dryad who wants to taste another clump, still innocently delighted and curious, not malicious. Warm late-afternoon natural light, shaded stone and greenery; gentle pale yellow-green moss glow rather than intense neon.

A distinctly NEW composition: full-body wide lateral staging, the camera perpendicular to the loading path, at normal human chest height. Merrill stands at the LEFT of the image in profile/three-quarter profile facing right, eager bare right hand slightly extended. Lico stands at the RIGHT facing left with both feet planted apart, hugging the single moss basket against her chest and physically blocking the path. Their whole figures including Lico's sandals and Merrill's boots are visible, with natural small statures, not elongated fashion figures. Allow a clear gap between them. Stacks of covered baskets and the escape/loading route continue behind Lico to the far right; tower wall frames the left. Show both faces in readable near profile, visually prioritize the contrast between Lico's determination and Merrill's appetite. This is a spacious scene of a blockade, not a close-up chase. No extra people.

Lico identity: human young woman around 18, short and sturdy rather than delicate; abundant distinct freckles across nose and cheeks, fine genuinely ROUND glasses slipping slightly down her nose, moss yellow-green eyes, messy dark reddish-brown short ponytail with flyaways and red spider-lily detail. Preserve her approachable, slightly odd face rather than smoothing her into a generic flawless beauty. Cream work apron over layered cream/olive rustic alchemist clothes with subdued red details, practical herbal pouches and small bottles, sandals. Follow reference 1 design. At this moment serious protectiveness, not a villain grin.
Merrill identity: youthful small dryad girl, short uneven green bob and green eyes, real red pomegranate flowers and leaves GROWING from the head, separate red ribbon. Cream blouse, short muted gray-green hooded jacket, practical dark shorts, sturdy lace-up boots and healthy strong legs; age-appropriate outdoor traveler design exactly matching reference 2. Oversized food-stuffed backpack with mushrooms, bread and wrapped provisions, a small pumpkin charm. Friendly curious expression with bright appetite, not cruel, no fangs, no drool.
Critical gauntlet: ONLY Merrill's anatomical LEFT arm wears the pomegranate-wood lyre GAUNTLET, integral strings along the DORSAL surface of her forearm, extending as fitted dorsal armor over the back of the hand and the back of all fingers to the fingertips. Palm and finger pads are open. Right hand and right forearm bare. It is NOT a separate U-shaped harp, NOT a harp glued to the arm, NOT vines growing from flesh. Study reference 2 carefully. Keep arm/wrist anatomy natural and prioritize the two-person emotional beat.

Style: high-quality warm painterly anime fantasy game CG matching the third reference's delicate detailed linework, nuanced eyes, textured layered cloth, wood and stone, cinematic depth and atmospheric light. The first two references determine facial and costume identities. Natural proportions, expressive readable faces, full-bleed composition. Moss basket and both faces should read even as a small image. No decorative border, text, labels, speech bubbles, hearts, watermark, blood, gore, attacks on ears, combat spell blasts, modern objects, costume redesign, duplicate limbs, extra fingers.
Create one standalone image only. This is a new alternative composition of the same exact scene, not a modification of facial identities or outfits. The basket is carried by Lico, never offered to Merrill. Merrill's eyes track the moss. Preserve freckles and ROUND glasses. Check LEFT gauntlet all five dorsal fingers extend through fingertips; RIGHT hand remains bare.
revisionPrompt:

Image 2 is the NEW authoritative Lico clothing color reference. Use it ONLY to update Lico's outfit, not to change the target's pose or composition.

Make exactly TWO requested changes:
1. Lico, the reddish-brown-haired bespectacled woman on the RIGHT, now wears the red-and-black outfit from image 2. NEW APPROVED COSTUME PALETTE: red and black must be unmistakably the dominant clothing colors. Charcoal-black hooded outer robe/mantle and long skirt (#242124), muted deep-crimson work apron (#862A37) with restrained dark botanical texture, slightly brighter blood-red spider-lily embroidery and red lining/ties (#A43640). Warm ivory blouse and tiny ruffle edges only as secondary contrast. Dark near-black brown leather bags, straps and sandals, antique brass hardware. No olive-green or beige dominance in the clothes. Moss-yellow-green eyes and glowing potion stay unchanged as SMALL complementary accents. Natural dyed linen and worn practical cloth, not glossy leather, not gothic aristocracy, not luxurious fashion. Keep the work apron instantly legible, simple and practical.
Match the color allocation precisely: deep red apron chest panel and the long apron down the FRONT; charcoal black outer cloak and lower skirt with red spider-lily embroidery and red inner lining; warm ivory sleeves and small hems. Preserve the existing garment silhouettes, seams, layering, accessories, her face, expression, freckles, round spectacles, yellow-green eyes, brown hair, hands, basket and feet. This is a natural practical herbal alchemist outfit, not a new ornate fashion costume.
2. Merrill, the green-haired traveler on the LEFT, should have noticeably fuller, sturdier legs, both thighs AND calves. Increase their width modestly but clearly, around 20 percent from the target image, with rounded healthy contours and natural knee/ankle transitions. The intent is a short, solidly built forest traveler, not a slender model. Keep the same stature, leg length, stance and exact foot positions. Adjust shorts leg openings, straps and boot cuffs naturally to fit without constriction or pinching. Keep clothing coverage unchanged and framing neutral and character-introduction focused. Do not change her face, torso, arms, costume colors, flowers or backpack. Keep the instrument gauntlet ONLY on her LEFT arm, its dorsal plates covering the back of hand and all fingers through the fingertips. Right arm bare.

LOCKED INVARIANTS: the full-body two-person wide composition and BOTH pairs of footwear completely visible; Merrill stays on the left, Lico on the right; same distance and stance, same tower/courtyard, handcart and baskets, lighting, time of day, camera, aspect ratio 1536x1024, painterly anime style, no text. Preserve Lico holding and protecting the basket (never handing it over), Merrill's hungry innocent smile and reaching pose. No changes besides outfit recolor and the modest leg-build adjustment. No cropped feet, no additional characters, no new accessories, no glamour posing.
